backing.collateral_ratio_basis: Issuer-reported external/owned strategy assets divided by net circulating NAV claims. Gross global supply times PPS is not this denominator; owned LP sfrxUSD sides and protocol/unissued/legacy bridge inventory are liability offsets, not external capital.
backing.coverage_note: No independently complete global asset/liability census, beneficial-ownership proof or independent global coverage ratio. Research checks issuer-listed claims; reserve-token balances are not realized dollars or proof of ultimate custody. Thin surplus can be consumed by strategy or valuation loss before frxUSD reserves are impaired.
backing.authored_vs_band_note: Written Backing 5.0/10 is historical research context, not a numeric dashboard override. No producer declaration of measurement impossibility is supplied; absence, failure or pending measurement does not authorize authored fallback.

research_snapshot.own_token_dust_note: About $123 of self-held sfrxUSD is not independent collateral. The quoted issuer total includes it; excluding it is immaterial. It is not silently reclassified as independent backing.

lp_reconciliation.note: Favorable reconstruction difference does not validate a global denominator or authorize replacing issuer coverage.

parent_layer.note: Separate upstream reserve layer, not additive sfrxUSD assets. Backing 5.0 does not inherit parent 6.5 because strategy claims can impair first.
